items.quote: All projects must be wholly in Illinois.

items.rule: Site owned by 501c3 or government, managed as habitat, with regular stewardship and public access in place or planned
items.quote: Eligible project sites are properties owned by a 501c3 organization, or a government agency, on which the applicant regularly performs, or is planning to regularly perform stewardship work, and is being managed as a natural habitat and wildlife area that is or will be open to the public.

items.rule: Submits only one application per grant cycle
items.quote: Applicants may only submit one application per grant cycle.

items.rule: Uses grant funds for stewardship at the site named in the application
items.quote: All funds provided by PSCC are to be dedicated to stewardship at the eligible project site identified in the grant application.

items.rule: Cash Donations and Volunteer Labor funds directly improve the site's natural habitat
items.quote: Grant dollars received under the Cash Donations and Volunteer Labor Categories must be used on activities directly related to improving the property’s natural habitat.

items.rule: Does not use grant funds to buy highway vehicles or trailers
items.quote: Grant funds may not be used to purchase highway vehicles (i.e. cars or trucks), or trailers.

items.rule: Buys funded equipment during the grant period and provides paid invoices for reimbursement
items.quote: Equipment must be purchased during the grant period and grant funds will be disbursed upon receipt and review of paid invoices.

items.item: Project Work Plan / Project Description Form
items.quote: This form is a required attachment of the Online Application.

items.item: Project budget organised by stewardship objectives and actions
items.quote: Your stewardship objectives and related actions should be used to organize the project budget.

items.item: Landowner approval letter for the proposed work
items.quote: A letter of approval from the landowner of your project site approving the applicant to carry out the proposed grant work on the site.

items.item: Maps showing the work site's location
items.quote: Maps showing the location of the work site

items.item: Operating budgets for the most recent fiscal year and upcoming year, if available
items.quote: Organizational or departmental operating budgets – one for the most recent fiscal year and one for the upcoming fiscal year, if available.

items.item: Latest fiscal-year financial report, including balance sheet, income statement and notes
items.quote: A financial report for the most recent fiscal year, including Balance Sheet, Income Statement, and any notes to financial statements
IRS Tax Status Determination Letter (for 501c3 applicants only)

items.item: Latest Illinois Charitable Organization Annual Report filed with the Attorney General
items.quote: Your organization’s most recent Illinois Charitable Organization Annual Report filed with the Illinois Attorney General’s Office (for 501c3 applicants only)

steps.quote: To begin the application process, applicants will need to complete a basic eligibility quiz to ensure applicants organization and project site are eligible under this program.

steps.step: Full proposal after passing the eligibility quiz
steps.quote: The period to submit Full Proposals will begin in 2027 on July 14th and close on September 17th

steps.step: PSCC staff review for accuracy, completeness and eligibility
steps.quote: Grant applications will be accepted and undergo initial review and evaluation by PSCC grant staff for accuracy, completion, and eligibility.

steps.step: Grant Committee review and award approval
steps.quote: Next, the Grant Committee will review grant applications, deliberate, and approve grant awards.
Finally, the PSCC Board will ratify all grant funding awards approved by the Grant Committee.

co_finance.quote: Documentation that new dollars have been raised, or like-kind (non-cash) donations have been made as match in the form of a list of donors and donations that is signed by an officer or director of the organization.
co_finance.detail_quote: Cash Donations: PSCC will provide $3 to every $1 raised toward the project within the grant period, up to $21,000.

items.quote: Take another set preceding the end of your grant period and submit both the “before” and “after” photos with your final report.

answer.notes: The live page gives the 2027 application dates but links 2026-named guidelines and forms and a December 2025 FAQ. Listed documents accompany the full proposal after the eligibility quiz. An IRS EIN confirmation letter is also required; its standalone source bullet has only four words, below the requested quote minimum. The 1:3 ratio applies only to Cash Donations; donated goods may count in that category. Volunteer services count separately: 400 hours qualify for $4,000. Equipment costs are reimbursed at 100%, up to $5,000. Payment claims require signed donor lists, verified volunteer records or equipment receipts, depending on category; the four-month claim interval is not a mandatory interim-report schedule. Grantees must separately track matching donations and grant funds and identify grant funds as restricted in their annual financial report. Unspent PSCC funds require a post-grant budget with the final report and must remain dedicated to the site's habitat.
